## Summary

Describe the purpose and user-facing effect of this change.

## Scope

- [ ] This pull request contains one focused, reviewable change.
- [ ] The canonical document was updated instead of creating a duplicate where appropriate.
- [ ] Related issues are linked, or the reason for not opening an issue is explained.

## Sources and accuracy

- [ ] Material claims are supported by authoritative sources or explicitly marked as planned, provisional, or unverified.
- [ ] Project implementation and release details link to their authoritative repositories.
- [ ] Dates, versions, compatibility statements, and status descriptions have been checked.

## Licensing and attribution

- [ ] New content follows the repository's scoped licensing policy.
- [ ] Third-party text, code, images, and other assets have appropriate rights and attribution.
- [ ] Project-specific licenses have not been overridden or conflated with this repository's license policy.

## Security and disclosure

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data, confidential material, private architecture, IP proofs, trade secrets, or unreleased security details are included.
- [ ] Screenshots, logs, and examples have been reviewed for sensitive data.
- [ ] Public security-sensitive findings have been routed through the private process in SECURITY.md.

## Documentation quality

- [ ] Frontmatter and filenames follow DOCUMENTATION-STANDARDS.md.
- [ ] Internal relative links resolve.
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly in GitHub and remains usable in Obsidian.
- [ ] The local validator passes: python scripts/validate_docs.py.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md and ROADMAP.md were updated when the change materially affects repository behavior or planned work.

## Review notes

List assumptions, limitations, risks, or follow-up work that reviewers should know.
